# SizeUpSC for South Carolina Communities

# SIZEUP VALUE PROPOSITION FOR SOUTH CAROLINA COMMUNITIES

Your local small businesses want to know what you’ve done for them lately. Through the state’s partnership with SizeUp, the Department of Commerce offers small businesses and entrepreneurs across the state data to benchmark themselves against their competition, gain valuable insights to craft their business plans, deeply understand the competitive landscape of their industry, and find the best places to advertise their goods and services. This valuable information comes directly from the [Department of Commerce’s website.](https://scbizdev.sccommerce.com/find-resources/markets-and-competition "SC Department of Commerce SizeUp Tool/info")

Now, communities in South Carolina can incorporate SizeUp into their small business and entrepreneurial ecosystem, at a reduced rate due to the existing state partnership. This data will be customized to your local geography and will include the existing statewide data sets, plus additional information to aid your local businesses: hourly wage, open hours, digital footprint, and in-depth demographics of your immediate area. All of this will be implemented onto your Chamber, EDO, or City website, available to your local small businesses and entrepreneurs, 24/7, 365 days a year.

**Low budget**

Reduced budget investment made possible by the State’s existing program.

**High value**

All the benefits of SizeUp for your local businesses.

**Positive perception**

Your EDO will look good by showing you support local businesses.

# **WHAT YOU WILL GET WITH SIZEUP**

## **What the State Has**

## **_PLUS!_**

## **Additional datasets**

### **Business performance**

**+**

### **Powerful Demographics**

[![Screenshot of MyBusiness Module](https://sc.sizeup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2022/05/MyBusinessModule.png "MyBusinessModule Screenshot")](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

[![Screen shot showing a preview of Demographics](https://sc.sizeup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2022/05/Demographics-Screenshot.png "Demographics Screenshot")](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

See how you size up by comparing your performance to all other competitors in your industry. SizeUp super-crunches millions of data points so businesses know where they rank. 

Interactively map demographic, labor force, and consumer expenditure data for your area. Tailor your analysis to the area around your address, or to a custom boundary.

### **Find Customers, Suppliers, & Competition**

**+**

### **Hourly Wage Insights**

[![Screen shot showing the Competitor's Module](https://sc.sizeup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2022/05/CompetitorsModule.png "CompetitorsModule")](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

[![Screen shot showing a preview of Hourly Wage by Occupation](https://sc.sizeup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2022/05/SizeUp-HR-Wage-by-Occupation-Screenshot.png "SizeUp HR Wage by Occupation Screenshot")](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

Find new customers, suppliers, and better understand the competitive landscape. Visualize new business opportunities through lists of companies and analysis of consumers.

Different occupations at the same company may pay different wages. You can use the Hourly Wages by Occupation to get detailed information by occupation and for hourly workers.

### **Advertising Tool**

**+**

### **Open Hours**

[![Screen shot showing the advertising module](https://sc.sizeup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2022/05/AdvertisingModule.png "AdvertisingModule")](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

[![Screen shot showing a preview of Open Hours](https://sc.sizeup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2022/05/Open-Hours.png "Open Hours")](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

Target your ideal customers based on the preferred client characteristics that matter to your company. Then, determine the best places to target your next marketing campaign. 

Measure the different times that businesses are open in your industry. The data is shown in multiple ways so that you can see the difference for each day of the week, weekdays, weekends, and the total week. 

### **Social Media Presence**

[Request Demo](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

[![Screen shot showing digital footprint](https://sc.sizeup.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2022/05/Digital-Footprint.png "Digital Footprint")](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)

Discover where your industry has it’s heaviest presence as digital business continues to grow in importance. A business’s online presence is frequently the first point of contact.  

## **AVAILABLE FOR**

**Any and every South Carolina geography**

*   *   **_Cities_**
    *   **_Counties_**
    *   **_Regions_**
    *   **_Districts_**

**Any and every South Carolina type of organization**

*   *   **_Government_**
    *   **_Public-private partnership_**
    *   **_Chamber of Commerce_**
    *   **_Small Business Development Center_**

# **PROGRAM FEATURES**

SizeUp SC uses award-winning Fintech software to provide a patented method of providing your local businesses with the same type of market research that used to only be available to the world’s largest corporations and international management consulting companies. Now your local businesses will have free access to:

*   Business Performance Ranking
*   Find Customers, Suppliers, and Competitors
*   Optimize Advertising through Targeted Marketing

[Request Demo](https://company.sizeup.com/demo-request/)
